vocabulary.meaning_en: a short statement of the main points
vocabulary.example: Here is a short summary of the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a general direction in which things are changing
the latest time to finish something
vocabulary.example: We finished just before the deadline.

vocabulary.note_ar: jump through hoops = يقوم بأشياء صعبة كثيرة
vocabulary.note_en: jump through hoops = do many difficult things
vocabulary.example: The dog jumped through a hoop.
Let's be flexible with our plans.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group meeting to share lots of ideas quickly
vocabulary.example: We had a brainstorming session for new ideas.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the amount of work you have to do
vocabulary.example: My workload is very heavy this month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: accept that you cannot win or succeed
vocabulary.example: After an hour, I admitted defeat.

fine_lines.title: jump the gun vs bite the bullet
fine_lines.explanation_ar: jump the gun = التسرّع والتصرف قبل الوقت المناسب. bite the bullet = مواجهة أمر صعب أو مزعج بشجاعة بعد التأجيل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Jump the gun" = act too early. "Bite the bullet" = bravely do something unpleasant that you have been avoiding.

examples.sentence: Let's not jump the gun; we haven't got the job yet.
I bit the bullet and went to the dentist.

fine_lines.title: throw in the towel vs get the ball rolling
fine_lines.explanation_ar: throw in the towel = الاستسلام والتوقف. get the ball rolling = بدء شيء ما. المعنيان متعاكسان.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Throw in the towel" = give up and stop. "Get the ball rolling" = start something. They are opposites.

examples.sentence: I couldn't solve the puzzle, so I threw in the towel.
Who wants to get the ball rolling with the first idea?

expressions.phrase: at the end of the day
expressions.meaning_en: Used to give a summary or the most important point.
expressions.example: It was a hard project, but at the end of the day we learnt a lot.

expressions.meaning_en: Used to say you have already done something, or to add a surprising fact.
expressions.example: Did you call the client? — As a matter of fact, I've just finished talking to him.

expressions.meaning_en: In general; mostly, with some exceptions.
expressions.example: By and large, the staff are happy with the new policy.

expressions.phrase: in the grand scheme of things
expressions.meaning_en: When you think about the bigger picture; it's not very important.
expressions.example: In the grand scheme of things, being 15 minutes late doesn't matter.

expressions.meaning_ar: في اللحظة الأخيرة / قبل فوات الأوان بقليل
expressions.meaning_en: Just in time, at the last possible moment.
expressions.example: We arrived at the airport in the nick of time.

expressions.meaning_ar: يقوم بأمور صعبة كثيرة (ليحصل على شيء)
expressions.meaning_en: Do a lot of difficult things to get something.
expressions.example: I had to jump through hoops to get my visa.
After trying for months, he finally threw in the towel.

expressions.phrase: have a lot on your plate
expressions.meaning_ar: لديه الكثير من المسؤوليات / مشغول جدًا
expressions.meaning_en: Have too much work or too many things to deal with.
expressions.example: I can't take on another project. I have a lot on my plate.

expressions.meaning_en: Let's not plan now; we'll decide as things happen.
expressions.example: I'm not sure when I'll finish work, so let's play it by ear.
Making an omelette is not rocket science.

expressions.meaning_en: A little ill; not feeling well.
expressions.example: I'm a bit under the weather today, so I'll stay home.

expressions.meaning_en: Do something too early, before the right time.
expressions.example: Let's not jump the gun and start planning before we decide.

expressions.meaning_en: Make yourself do something difficult or unpleasant.
expressions.example: I'm nervous, but I'll bite the bullet and give the presentation.
Let's get the ball rolling. Who has the first idea?

expressions.phrase: hit the nail on the head
expressions.example: You've hit the nail on the head. We didn't reply to the customer fast enough.

expressions.meaning_en: The whole situation, not just small details.
expressions.example: Don't worry about small mistakes; look at the bigger picture.
After the first presentation, the next one will be a piece of cake.

grammar.title: Idioms: the meaning is not in the words
grammar.explanation_ar: التعابير الاصطلاحية (idioms) لا يُفهم معناها من كلماتها منفردة: under the weather لا علاقة لها بالطقس بل تعني متوعّك. تعلّمها كوحدة واحدة مع مثال.
grammar.explanation_en: Idioms don't mean what their words say: "under the weather" means ill, not about weather. Learn each one as a whole phrase with an example.
examples: I'm under the weather. (= a bit ill)
It's not rocket science. (= it's easy)
You hit the nail on the head. (= exactly right)

grammar.title: Idioms as verbs change tense
grammar.explanation_ar: التعابير التي تبدأ بفعل يتغير فعلها حسب الزمن: throw → threw، bite → bit، hit → hit.
grammar.explanation_en: Idioms that start with a verb change tense: throw → threw, bite → bit, hit → hit.
examples: He threw in the towel last week.
I bit the bullet and called my boss.
She hit the nail on the head.

questions.question: "I'm a bit under the weather" means:
We caught the train just before it left. We arrived ___.
choices: at the end of the day
questions.explanation_ar: in the nick of time = في اللحظة الأخيرة.
questions.explanation_en: "In the nick of time" = just in time.

questions.question: "I can't help you this week. I have a lot ___ my plate."
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح: have a lot on my plate (لديّ الكثير من المهام).
questions.explanation_en: have a lot on my plate.

questions.question: Which idiom means "give up"?
choices: hit the nail on the head

questions.question: "You've hit the nail on the head!" means:
questions.explanation_ar: hit the nail on the head = أصاب تمامًا.

questions.question: We haven't got the job yet. Let's not ___.
"By and large, people are happy" means:
I was nervous, but I ___ the bullet and went to the dentist.
"Let's play it by ear" means:
choices: Let's decide later, as things happen.
Let's make a fixed plan now.
questions.explanation_ar: play it by ear = نتصرف حسب الظروف.
questions.explanation_en: It means decide later, as things happen.
